title: Cards show what they remember
notes: Every card whose text turns on something it or the game remembers shows it in its text through its preview (R2476000, issue #2476's pass over the catalog: 33 cards). The previews change only the views, but the classifier counts a view change as play, so it names the previewed cards and the cards played on a step where a preview changed. Seven scripts grow past COMPLICATED_CODE_LINES and join Shockwave447's complicated cards (R1846000, R2173001).

player.title: Cards show what they remember
changes: Shockwave447's complicated cards now include Jackiestan Auctioneer, Memory Leak, Clip-Farming Critikal, Eschews, BALTHASAR, Tiny Asteroid and Trigor.
text: Cards that remember something now show it in their text: the Unit Carnivorous Cube ate, the deaths Eschews has counted, the card held beneath Ticketed, and 30 more.
